HOW IT WORKS

GAME RULES

SELECTED CHARACTER Clawster
CURRENT LEVEL Bedroom · Difficulty 1/4
YOUR OBJECTIVE

SOCK THIEF

Steal and escape

  1. Collect every orange loot item in the room. Socks, keys, buttons and other objects all count toward the objective.
  2. Move on the floor and the highlighted furniture tops. Gaps between the light lines are not landing surfaces.
  3. Jump toward an edge to pull yourself up. Use W/S near marked fabric, handles and pipes to climb.
  4. Watch the warning meter: Draco roams unpredictably until he sees or hears you.
  5. Violet outlines mark hiding places. Break Draco's line of sight, move close and press Q, F or the HIDE touch button.
  6. Collect everything before time runs out, then reach the orange exit.
DRACO

Guard the house

  1. Blue shield markers are socks to protect. Draco cannot collect them; they show where the Crew is heading.
  2. Catch every thief before all protected socks disappear. Draco has no time limit.
  3. Move, jump and climb through the same room routes as the Crew.
  4. The thieves run, jump, climb, use their own abilities and hide when you get close.
  5. Touch a visible thief to catch them. Violet hiding markers show where a thief may disappear.
  6. Guardian Pulse briefly stuns nearby thieves, but does not catch them automatically.

Controls

AD / ←→ Move SPACE Jump – hold toward an edge to pull yourself up WS / ↑↓ Climb fabric, furniture and pipes Q / F Hide or leave your hiding place E / SHIFT Special ability P / ESC Pause M Music on/off

Draco warning

CLEAR

Draco is roaming between the floor and furniture but has not noticed you.

SUSPICIOUS

He heard or saw something. Slow down and leave the area.

SPOTTED

Draco is chasing you. Break his line of sight and reach a hiding place.

SEARCHING

He is checking where he last saw you. Wait until the room is clear.

Selected ability

Tip: running footsteps and marked floor zones make more noise. Progress is saved automatically in your browser.
